description: This file defines a PHP class `ADODB2_mysql` that extends `ADODB_DataDict`, providing MySQL-specific implementations for database schema manipulation within the ADOdb abstraction layer. It includes methods for mapping data types, generating SQL statements for index creation/deletion, and other database-related functions tailored for MySQL.

classes.name: ADODB2_mysql
classes.description: A PHP class implementing MySQL-specific database schema operations for the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps a database field type to an internal type code used by ADOdb, with special handling for serial types and binary data.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts internal type codes back into MySQL data type definitions.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffixes for column definitions based on attributes like unsigned, not null, default, auto-increment, and constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL statements for adding, replacing, or dropping indexes and keys on MySQL tables.
